name: vc-test
description: PREVIEW — one testing flow for a Virto Commerce ticket: /vc-test:ticket-context → change map → scored scenarios approved at one human point → one agent per scenario plus a background AC run → triage → Medium-only investigation → verdict, with tokens and minutes per step. /vc-test:init declares which environments a run may write to and the project's knowledge store. Ships /vc-test:ticket-context and /vc-test:qa-test-strategy with their agents (ticket-context-analyst, strategy-verifier, fetch) and the run's own narrow agents (change-map, checklist-writer, verdict-writer); /vc-test:ticket-context reads Jira or Azure Boards and GitHub or Azure Repos only through $VC_RUN, holding no token, or, on a host-governed project, through the host's MCP servers with the fetch agent. /vc-test:qa-triage-results (both modes) and its ticket-mode collector are in the plugin; investigation is vc-fix:qa-investigate. /vc-test:qa-design and the ui-ux-expert agent run the visual lane, on a Playwright lane the run leaves free, with the layout-measurement code as a generated lib/design/. Depends on vc-init (profile, $VC_RUN, the script runner) and vc-fix.
